jtbd.jtbd_desc: Differentiate USC supplements with proof-over-prose artifacts, scene-first storytelling, and portfolio cross-links.

interactions.user_ask: How do I stand out in USC short answers without repeating Common App?
interactions.jenny_reply: Anchor in one crisp scene per answer; link out to a tiny proof (demo clip, published post, or repo) rather than re-explaining.

interactions.user_ask: What should I prioritize this week for USC?
interactions.jenny_reply: Ship two micro-artifacts: (1) 60–90s Synthoria explainer clip; (2) EmpowAI editorial screenshot with byline. Both linkable from Activities.
